DONATION POPUP
Donation Popup settings
Manage product behavior, form look, and the success screen in one place — changes show up instantly in the live preview.

SETUP
Products

Design
FORMS
Popup
Normal
Share-based
Progress
Success
MORE
Meta Pixel
Categories
Advanced
Meta Pixel (WDP)
This section uses the site’s existing pixel (for example the WooCommerce / Meta integration); by default it does not add a second pixel or PageView. ViewContent and AddToCart are sent from this plugin; InitiateCheckout and Purchase are left to WooCommerce / Meta by default.
Enable Meta tracking Enabled
Require cookie consent Enabled
When on, the Pixel and events run only when marketing consent is present. WP Consent API is not loaded: consent must be reported with the “wdp_meta_pixel_has_consent” filter (default: no consent). When off, the previous behavior is kept.
Send ViewContent when the form opens Enabled
Send AddToCart after adding to the cart Enabled
Send Purchase from the donation plugin Enabled
Sends Purchase from this plugin on the thank-you / order received page. Leave it off if WooCommerce / Meta already sends Purchase.
Custom debug events (DonationFormOpen, etc.) Enabled
Console debug log (no personal data) Enabled
Load the base Meta pixel from this plugin (off by default) Enabled
Send InitiateCheckout from the plugin (off by default; may conflict with WooCommerce) Enabled
Purchase: also allow on-hold orders (bank transfer, etc.) Enabled
Optional Pixel ID
Used only when “load the base pixel” is on. Leave empty if the site already loads a pixel.
